    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandMeal" name="Hand over meal at service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealHandover"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_7" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="ManualTask_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_8" sourceRef="ManualTask_PrepareMeal" targetRef="ManualTask_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_9" sourceRef="ManualTask_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_10" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="SendTask_SetOffBuzzer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_12" sourceRef="Gateway_EmpWait" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_13" sourceRef="Gateway_EmpWait" targetRef="Timer_5Minutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FR_17" sourceRef="SendTask_HandMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_Restaurant"/>
  </bpmn:process>
